model: Current simulator analytical projected margin, reconstructed pre-week statistics, fixed BASE ratings
method: Grid searched power weights 0..1 by 0.05; home margin calibration -5..+6 by 0.5; train weeks 1-5 and held out weeks 6-8. Accuracy excludes pushes. Individual lines are historical provider lines, not verified closing snapshots. Parameter selection on train only; do not rank by holdout.
conclusion: No parameter tuning tested beat the always-home benchmark on the holdout. Do not deploy optimized weights as a predictive improvement. Existing site ratings may themselves contain in-season information; a robust test needs archived preseason/week-specific ratings, verified timestamps for odds, prior seasons, and a larger untouched test window.
